parts.text: A student investigates the refraction of light in the material of a transparent block. Fig. 3.1 shows the ray-trace sheet. The student places a transparent block on the sheet and labels the block ABCD. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) On Fig. 3.1, draw a normal NL to the side AB of the transparent block at a distance 2.0 cm from A. Continue the normal so that it passes through side CD of the block. Label the point S where NL crosses AB. [2]

ms.label: 3(a)
ms.text:
Normal at 90°
2 cm (± 2 mm) from A

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) • Draw a line RS at an angle i = 30° to the normal, above AB and to the left of the normal. • The student places two pins P 1 and P 2 on line RS. Mark, with two crosses (X), on line RS, positions of the pins at a suitable distance apart for this experiment. [2]

ms.label: 3(b)
ms.text:
Incident ray at 30° ± 2° to left of normal
P1 P2 separation at least 5.0 cm

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student looks from the position of the eye shown in Fig. 3.1, to observe the images of P 1 and P 2 through side CD of the block. He adjusts his line of sight until the images of P 1 and P 2 appear exactly one behind the other. He places two pins P 3 and P 4 between side CD of the block and his eye so that P 3 , P 4 and the images of P 1 and P 2 seen through the block, appear exactly one behind the other. The positions of P 3 and P 4 are shown on Fig. 3.1. • Draw a line through the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Continue the line until it meets the normal NL and label that point E. • Label the other end of the line F. • Measure the acute angle θ between EF and the normal. An acute angle is an angle less than 90°. angle θ = ......................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(c)
ms.text:
Single, neat line through P3 and P4 and continued to meet normal
r 32° ± 1°

parts.label: i
parts.text: (d) (i) Tick one box to complete the sentence. To produce the most accurate ray-trace, a student places the pins P 1 and P 2 exactly 5.0 cm apart. less than 5.0 cm apart. more than 5.0 cm apart. [1]

ms.label: 3(d)(ii)
ms.text:

1
Draw thin lines / use sharp pencil
2

3

ms.label: 3(e)
ms.text:
At least 3 extra values (all < 90°) given
Range to spread over at least 30°
